title: MCI · 5G
summary: An unexpected expression of speed: slow creatures become the stars of MCI’s 5G campaign.
clientDescription: Mobile Communications of Iran (Hamrah Aval), a mobile network operator in Iran.
challenge: Make the abstract promise of 5G speed instantly memorable across outdoor and digital media.
role: Visual concept, key visual design, art direction and compositing.
deliverables: Campaign key visuals and executions for outdoor and digital placements.
credits: Campaign concept and design by Ali Komeili. Portfolio imagery newly recreated from the original project as presentation studies.

blocks.title: Speed, seen differently.
blocks.text: A snail and a tortoise are the last things we expect to move fast. That contradiction gives the 5G message an immediate, memorable visual hook.

blocks.alt: Snail speeding on a skateboard through a cyan light trail

alts: Tortoise riding a skateboard in a blue motion field
Overhead view of a snail on a skateboard

blocks.title: Still images with forward momentum.
blocks.text: Precisely directed light, sharp subject detail and controlled motion cues create the sensation of acceleration. Each composition keeps the creature readable while the world around it moves.

blocks.alt: Rocket-powered snail framed by a fine cyan portal on a wrinkled MCI 5G billboard near Azadi Tower in Tehran
